title: My Crush’s Crush Anime Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, Staff, Cast, April 2027 Premiere
content:
The previously announced My Crush’s Crush anime revealed a teaser visual and a trailer on Monday. The main staff and cast and an April 2027 premiere date, have also been announced. Studio project No.9 is in charge of the animation.

Kazuomi Koga is directing the anime with Yoriko Tomita handling the series scripts. Takayuki Noguchi is designing the characters, and Rina Tayama is composing the music. The main cast includes:

• Gakuto Kajiwara as Sora Akizuki

• Haruna Mikawa as Asahi Suzukaze

• Nene Hieda as Miya Fuwa

The anime is based on a manga written by Sekina Aoi and illustrated by Ryo Tsuzura. It is currently serialized in Hakusensha’s Young Animal ZERO . Yen Press is licensing the title in English, describing it as follows: When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright. As it turns out, she likes Asahi Suzukaze, the president of the mysterious “Clinical Trials Club.” When he joins the club to learn more about Asahi, he discovers that she also has a crush on someone else! Could this chain of crushes get any more complicated…? Source: My Crush’s Crush anime Official website , X (formerly Twitter) © Sekina Aoi, Tsuzura Ryo/Hakusensha/”The Person I Like” Production Committee

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns Record $32 Million in N. American Opening Weekend
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , earned an estimated US$31.61 million at the North American box office in its opening weekend. A record 74% of that total came from premium large format screenings, with 40% or US$12 million from IMAX screenings. (It is the first Japanese film to meet the standard to advertise itself as "filmed for IMAX.")

This is the highest ever U.S. opening weekend for a GKIDS release (higher than The Boy and the Heron 's US$13 million in 2023 ), as well as the highest one ever for a live-action foreign film. (The highest one for a foreign film is still the first Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle anime film with US$70.6 million, unadjusted for inflation, in September 2025. The English dub of Pokémon: The First Movie opened with US$50.8 million in its first five days in July 1998.)

Godzilla Minus Zero 's global revenue stands at US$63 million after its opening weekend. Deadline reports it was the highest-grossing film in the world this past weekend.

The film earned 590,000 tickets for 910 million yen (about US$5.75 million) in Japan in its opening day alone, setting a new record for the highest opening day earnings for a live-action film (among both foreign and domestic live-action films) in Japan. The film had 201% higher opening day earnings than its predecessor Godzilla Minus One in Japan.

The film opened in Japan on Tuesday, November 3, which is "Godzilla Day" in Japan, celebrating the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. Godzilla Minus One similarly opened in Japan on November 3, 2023. (Godzilla Day fell on a Tuesday this year, but it is also the Japanese holiday known as Culture Day.)

The sequel is set in 1949, two years after the Godzilla Minus One film's story.

Min Tanaka ( 47 Ronin , live-action Rurouni Kenshin films) plays biologist Kanji Murakami. He joined returning cast members Ryūnosuke Kamiki (Koichi Shikishima), Minami Hamabe (Noriko Ōishi), and Hidetaka Yoshioka (Noda) from Godzilla Minus One . Also returning in the cast are Yūki Yamada (Shiro Mizushima), Kuranosuke Sasaki (Seiji Akitsu), Sakura Andō (Sumiko Ota), and Miō Tanaka (Tatsuo Ho tta).

Yamazaki returned as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Naoki Satō also returned to compose the music. Shirogumi Inc. handled the film's visual effects.

GKIDS and TOHO released the film in North America on Friday, November 6. This is the first time a Japan-produced Godzilla film opened in Japan and in North America in the same week.

In addition to opening in Japan and North America, it opened in the same week in Latin America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand. The companies stated they would announce additional international release dates at a later time. TOHO acquired GKIDS in October 2024.

Godzilla Minus One has earned more than US$116 million worldwide. According to Box Office Mojo, the film has earned an estimated US$57,144,669 in the United States. The film was the third highest-grossing foreign-language film in the United States as of 2024.

Netflix is streaming the film and Godzilla Minus One /Minus Color , the black-and-white version of the film, worldwide on Netflix . In North America, Godzilla Minus One and Godzilla Minus One /Minus Color are additionally available for digital rental and digital purchase on Amazon, Apple iTunes , Google Play , Microsoft , FandangoNOW/ VUDU , inDemand, XBOX, and Vubiquity. In Japan, the film is streaming exclusively (in color and monochrome) on Amazon Prime Video .

Godzilla Minus One won the Best Visual Effects award in the 96th Academy Awards in March 2024. The film is the first Japanese film to win in this category, and the first Godzilla film to be nominated for an Oscar.

Yamazaki's first English-language film Grandgear was originally slated to open on February 18, 2028, but Sony Pictures recently moved up its release date to January 14, 2028.

title: Netflix’s Most Romantic Christmas Episode of 2026 Is Already Here
content:
An ongoing anime currently airing on Netflix has just delivered its most perfect Christmas-themed romantic episode of 2026, and it will be very hard to top anytime soon. As a streaming platform, Netflix has a knack for delivering series that perfectly match the theme of the season. It delivered Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 during the final days of the last month, perfectly capturing the Halloween vibe. Now, naturally, all eyes are on Christmas, the next big event that brings the holiday season with it. The platform will undoubtedly deliver many series and movies that capture the spirit of the most festive time of the year.

However, the Christmas spirit has already begun to take shape in an ongoing romantic sports anime series. Among the wave of anime scheduled to air on Netflix in Fall 2026 , Blue Box Season 2 was one of the most anticipated entries. The sports-driven romantic comedy’s second season was set to adapt a major arc for its main characters, as Chinatsu prepares for the Nationals amid the fall season’s matches. The latest episode captures this perfectly, culminating in a moment that highlights how all the previous episodes had been building toward this Christmas Day event.

Blue Box Season 2 Just Delivered Netflix’s Perfect Romantic Christmas Episode

Blue Box Season 2 Episode 5, titled “It’s Back,” continues the story with Yumeka arriving to watch Chinatsu’s basketball match on Christmas Day, something Taiki went through a lot to make happen. After watching Chinatsu play basketball, Yumeka is able to reignite her passion for the sport, allowing the two to reconcile and rekindle their lost friendship. The most important element of their exchange is how Chinatsu learns that Yumeka got the tickets to the match thanks to Taiki’s extra effort. This makes her realize that Taiki doesn’t just have feelings for her but also genuinely wishes for her well-being and wants to help resolve the problems in her life.

This prompts Chinatsu to look for Taiki after the match on Christmas Day. She eventually finds him at school, having gone to great lengths to search for him everywhere because he couldn’t answer his phone while practicing. The episode ends with Chinatsu and Taiki finally coming face-to-face, subtly implying that Chinatsu has also begun developing the same feelings for him. There is no need for anything else to explain the situation. It is the first moment when the series solidifies their budding romance through actions rather than words. This is exactly what makes Blue Box such a special romantic anime series.

The driving force behind both characters is their passion for sports and the inspiration they draw from each other, rather than mere attraction or a crush. This has motivated both characters, especially Taiki, to find inspiration and take action so that Chinatsu can maintain her motivation. After all, consistency and training are difficult to sustain in sports that demand rigorous preparation to reach the top. This is exactly why the latest episode of Blue Box Season 2 on Netflix is the perfect romantic episode of the series . It delivers the results of the consistency that Taiki and Chinatsu have demonstrated in every aspect of their relationship, all elevated by the Christmas theme, making it the best Christmas romantic episode of 2026 on Netflix so far.

title: AI Controversy Puts Critically Acclaimed Vinland Saga Creator in the Spotlight
content:
The creator of the critically acclaimed seinen manga series Vinland Saga , Makoto Yukimura, has found himself caught in an unnecessary AI controversy. Yukimura is one of the most profound storytellers in the manga industry, and Vinland Saga , which ran for 20 years, is proof of that. On top of crafting an epic story, Yukimura is also known for his exceptional artwork. Some details in the manga are illustrated with a level of craftsmanship that few other series can compete with. This is perhaps why Makoto Yukimura’s recent comment about AI has sparked controversy across the internet.

It has been over a year since the manga series came to an end , and the author has been taking something of a vacation, as he has openly expressed on X. Yukimura also regularly comments on fans’ posts, engaging with them whenever he can, especially when appreciating the effort they put into their work. One way he does this is by commenting on fan art inspired by the series. However, a recent piece of fan art that Yukimura appreciated, which apparently was created using AI, has landed him in trouble. It puts Yukimura in a rather human and innocent position amid the ongoing debate surrounding the use of AI in art.

Vinland Saga Creator Fears AI Rather Than Supporting It

After learning from a fan that the recent artwork perfectly capturing Thorfinn as a renowned character was created using AI, Makoto Yukimura simply remarked that AI does a good job. This naturally landed him in controversy, with some fans interpreting his response as a sign that the author supports AI. However, hours later, after realizing how fans were reacting to his post, he shared another clarification on X, explaining what he actually meant. He explained that AI steals art and that he is in trouble if AI develops too much, especially considering that it already does a good job to some extent. He stated that this is a fact, not an affirmation. This clearly implies that Yukimura fears what could happen if AI continues to develop, particularly for artists like him, who could eventually be replaced by AI systems that steal other people’s work and put those actually creating something new out of a job.

The usage of AI in manga has become a highly controversial topic in recent times , especially as some artists fully support the idea of incorporating AI into their work. One manga artist even claimed that the primary reason he would be taking a break was because he hoped that AI usage would eventually be allowed, enabling him to produce manga faster. Meanwhile, it was also recently revealed that AI was used in the creation of the Chainsaw Man anime. These are clear signs that perceptions of AI usage in the anime and manga industries are actively changing.

This ultimately brings the industry to a point where some people will have no problem with the use of AI in art, while others will strongly oppose it. AI has significantly changed the art industry, impacting anime and manga as well, and it is only going to take on new forms from here. What matters is that there are still authentic artists like Vinland Saga creator Makoto Yukimura who do not support the incorporation of AI into art. While new manga artists may choose to use AI, authentic artists and their work will continue to exist, giving fans something to treasure forever, especially if AI-generated art takes over in the future.

title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Gives Super Saiyan God Goku vs. Beerus Major Upgrade
content:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has finally kicked off the fight between Super Saiyan God Goku and Beerus with the newest episode of the remake, and it’s given the fight a major upgrade compared to what was seen before. This is now the third take on the fight between Goku and Beerus as the new remake anime series is offering an enhanced version of the classic TV anime series from over a decade ago. Given that it was a fight also seen in Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods , there’s a lot riding on it.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus seemed to be heading in the right direction with its enhanced take on Super Saiyan God Goku’s debut , and that now continues with the latest episode as he is fighting full force against Beerus. The latest episode of the remake series has kicked off the fight between the two, and condenses about three episodes of the classic series into a much more streamlined version of the fight. And it’s all paid off well thus far.

Dragon Ball Super Remake Enhances Super Saiyan Goku vs. Beerus Fight

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 5 kicks off the fight between Goku and Beerus in full, and Goku’s new Super Saiyan God form made him a closer match to the God of Destruction than the first time around. This is also a much cleaner version of the fight as the original TV anime had extended many of these moments across three episodes. The fight has a lot of moments where Beerus is testing the extent of Goku’s abilities, and he’s enjoying seeing a potential worthy opponent developing before his eyes in the process. But now that’s conveyed in a much tighter timeframe.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is only five episodes into its run, and it has already reached the climax of the Battle of Gods arc with its next episode. That’s a much more suitable pace for the arc when considering its original movie origins, and fixes a big complaint that fans had about the original TV series at the time. But at the same time, the remake has made some awkward changes to how it has been progressing things so far with what the team deems “important” enough to keep in this version of the story .

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ?

With the Battle of Gods arc reaching its climax with the next episode as Goku fades out of his use of the Super Saiyan God power, it likely means that the arc will be wrapped up within the next two episodes at the most. It’s yet to be revealed how many episodes Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be lasting for this Fall, but it will continue with newly enhanced versions of the Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs next. But it’s not clear what ways those arcs will be changed for this new version.

Though most of the notable changes have meant the story has been more streamlined, there’s not enough of the new material that fans had been hoping to see. While there are new cuts in the animation, new visual effects, and new sound design through each of the episodes, voice stars hadn’t re-recorded their lines for the new effort so it’s resulted in an awkward blend of new visuals with older audio as a result. But how are you feeling about Dragon Ball Super: Beerus so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Darkest Fantasy of the 2000s Is Making a Huge Comeback on Netflix After 3 Years
content:
Black Butler is finally returning to Netflix after it was removed from the platform in October 2023. Among the 2000s anime classics, Black Butler still stands out for its exceptional storytelling and complex characters. Written and illustrated by Yana Toboso, this award-winning manga began serializing in Square Enix’s GFantasy magazine on September 16th, 2006. This dark fantasy centers around a young boy named Ciel Phantomhive who sold his soul to a demon named Sebastian. The series is still ongoing and continues to return with new seasons, which is all the more reason why Netflix is bringing back the series to its library.

Whether it’s the premise or the storytelling, Black Butler stands out for having unique elements that are appreciated by fans even now. Since the anime is commemorating a major milestone this year , fans can also expect new surprises, including an exhibition, merchandise, and much more. Additionally, What’s on Netflix confirmed that the first two seasons of the hit supernatural series will return to the platform on November 15th, 2026. However, the other installments of the franchise, including the sequel seasons and the movies, haven’t been confirmed to drop on Netflix yet, but we can expect an update in the next few months.

Black Butler Is Commemorating Its 20th Anniversary With Exciting Projects

For a franchise as beloved as Black Butler , it’s no surprise that a major milestone like the 20th anniversary will be more than exciting enough. The series opened a new online portal to share all the updates on the upcoming projects. The website also includes a heartwarming message from the creator to fans who have been supporting the series throughout these years. Additionally, the series also released a promotional video reflecting on the 20-year-long journey throughout the release of the manga, anime, and even the hit live-action adaptation. The website also reveals the first look at the new range of exclusive merchandise for the anniversary celebrations.

Not only that, but an exhibition will also be held in Japan, which will be bigger than anything fans have seen from the anime. However, there haven’t been any updates regarding the anime’s future. So far, the anime has adapted up until the Emerald Witch Arc , which means the next season will cover the fan-favorite Blue Cult Arc. The story will bring in new challenges for Ciel as he tries to uncover the truth behind the strange incidents happening in the Sphere Musical Hall. While Netflix has only confirmed bringing the first two seasons, you can catch up with the rest of the anime on Crunchyroll.

Black Butler Deserves a Reboot for a Faithful Manga Adaptation

Over the years, there have been several controversies regarding the anime adaptation, especially for the first two seasons. The anime deviated from the original story during the first half of Season 1. Due to the fillers and the excessive changes, the anime adaptation was never able to do justice to the exceptional story. Not to mention that the manga follows a much darker story compared to the anime, which focused more on comedic relief even in dangerous situations. The visuals and the sound effects significantly changed the perception of the story, making it seem less dark than what the creator originally intended in the manga. Not only that, but the second season is entirely non-canon, since it introduces several plot lines and characters that were never mentioned in the original manga. Fortunately, the anime’s later installments , including the movies and the sequel seasons, remained faithful to the original story.

Are you excited for Black Butler ‘s new season? Also, let us know in the comments if you also hope to see an anime reboot.

Written and illustrated by Yana Toboso, this award-winning manga began serializing in Square Enix’s GFantasy magazine on September 16th, 2006. This dark fantasy centers around a young boy named Ciel Phantomhive who sold his soul to a demon named Sebastian. The series is still ongoing and continues to return with new seasons, which is all the more reason why Netflix is bringing back the series to its library.

Whether it’s the premise or the storytelling, Black Butler stands out for having unique elements that are appreciated by fans even now. Since the anime is commemorating a major milestone this year , fans can also expect new surprises, including an exhibition, merchandise, and much more. Additionally, What’s on Netflix confirmed that the first two seasons of the hit supernatural series will return to the platform on November 15th, 2026. However, the other installments of the franchise, including the sequel seasons and the movies, haven’t been confirmed to drop on Netflix yet, but we can expect an update in the next few months.
Black Butler Is Commemorating Its 20th Anniversary With Exciting Projects

For a franchise as beloved as Black Butler , it’s no surprise that a major milestone like the 20th anniversary will be more than exciting enough. The series opened a new online portal to share all the updates on the upcoming projects. The website also includes a heartwarming message from the creator to fans who have been supporting the series throughout these years. Additionally, the series also released a promotional video reflecting on the 20-year-long journey throughout the release of the manga, anime, and even the hit live-action adaptation. The website also reveals the first look at the new range of exclusive merchandise for the anniversary celebrations.

Not only that, but an exhibition will also be held in Japan, which will be bigger than anything fans have seen from the anime. However, there haven’t been any updates regarding the anime’s future. So far, the anime has adapted up until the Emerald Witch Arc , which means the next season will cover the fan-favorite Blue Cult Arc. The story will bring in new challenges for Ciel as he tries to uncover the truth behind the strange incidents happening in the Sphere Musical Hall. While Netflix has only confirmed bringing the first two seasons, you can catch up with the rest of the anime on Crunchyroll.
Black Butler Deserves a Reboot for a Faithful Manga Adaptation

Over the years, there have been several controversies regarding the anime adaptation, especially for the first two seasons. The anime deviated from the original story during the first half of Season 1. Due to the fillers and the excessive changes, the anime adaptation was never able to do justice to the exceptional story. Not to mention that the manga follows a much darker story compared to the anime, which focused more on comedic relief even in dangerous situations. The visuals and the sound effects significantly changed the perception of the story, making it seem less dark than what the creator originally intended in the manga. Not only that, but the second season is entirely non-canon, since it introduces several plot lines and characters that were never mentioned in the original manga. Fortunately, the anime’s later installments , including the movies and the sequel seasons, remained faithful to the original story.
Are you excited for Black Butler ‘s new season? Also, let us know in the comments if you also hope to see an anime reboot.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Creator Teases Future Return of the Avatar Cycle
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has wrapped up the first season of its run now streaming with Paramount+, and the co-creator behind the entire franchise has teased that Pavi and Nisha could reconnect with the Avatar Cycle someday despite its current status. One of Korra’s biggest moves as the Avatar during The Legend of Korra was the fact that she had disconnected herself from the Avatar Cycle ( which led to some very negative responses ), and it’s meant that every other Avatar to follow would also not have access to all of those from the past.

Avatar: Seven Havens seemed to tease that as Pavi began tapping into her chakras, she was also forming a better connection with the past Avatars as she briefly saw them in the form of constellations . While franchise co-creator Michael DiMartino confirmed to IGN that this wasn’t Pavi reconnecting to the Avatar Cycle, the creator does hint that it will come back in the future with the particular wording he uses, “It can’t happen that easily.” Which means it actually can happen through other circumstances.

Avatar: Seven Havens Co-Creator Teases Avatar Cycle Return

“It’s something else,” DiMartino explained about Pavi’s visions of the past Avatars in Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ final slate of episodes. “She has not reconnected. It can’t happen that easily. So she does have a connection with Korra, but the other stuff’s more of a vision.” While this is a confirmation that Pavi hasn’t reconnected with the Avatar Cycle in the finale, it’s also teasing that she will be able to reconnect with it in the future. Especially now that she’s already started to connect with Korra in other ways through her mastery of chakra .

While Pavi won’t have access to the Avatar Cycle or Avatar State, DiMartino’s words here confirm that it is possible to connect back to all of it. The team must have figured out how it would actually work, and that likely means Pavi (or Nisha) is already on the way towards getting there. The clearest path forward is the one presented in the finale too as Pavi is now tasked with exploring the other Havens in future seasons and figuring out how to tap into the powers of her seven chakras.

What Does This Mean for Pavi’s Future in Avatar: Seven Havens ?

Avatar: Seven Havens ends its first season with Pavi learning that she needs to tap into the second of her chakras, and will be able to do so with the Floating Isles Haven as she begins to see the rest of the world. We’ve already seen the kind of power that can result of that with the debut of Pavi’s new “Charka State” form in those final episodes, and there’s a good chance that a mastery of all of the other chakras will deepen her connection with the Avatar Cycle too.

Pavi already seeing an image of Korra has proven that even tapping into just the Root Chakra is helping her get closer to all of the other Avatars of the past. As Pavi learns more about Korra’s life and what led to the cataclysm through her journey across the Havens, she’ll undoubtedly discover how to connect back to the Avatar Cycle. At least it means it’s not as impossible as it seemed before, but what do you think? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – IGN

title: Godzilla Minus Zero VFX Team Break Down Ghidorah’s Most Challenging Moment in New Movie [EXCLUSIVE]
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero officially introduces a new take on Toho’s classic kaiju King Ghidorah, and the visual effects team behind it all opened up to ComicBook all about the challenges of bringing the famous monster to life. Godzilla Minus Zero is filled with a number of surprises, and that includes the debut of a second major monster from the classic Godzilla film library that had been hid from the film’s official promotional materials until the film’s debut weekend at the box office.

Godzilla Minus Zero really went all out for its visual effects much like the first film, and ComicBook got the chance to speak with the team behind it all, Takayuki Ueki and Tatsumi Nojima all about bringing this new version of King Ghidorah to life. As the team detailed, it took a multi-person effort to handle Ghidorah’s various phases as that ultimately ended up being the most challenging aspect of this new era of the kaiju.

Godzilla Minus Zero Team Breaks Down King Ghidorah’s VFX

As Ueki explained, the most challenging point of King Ghidorah’s design was its transformation, and the phases that it goes through during Godzilla Minus Zero . It’s especially notable when breaking it down from its point of origin, “From something that it just looks like it’s sleeping on the ground, not knowing what kind of form or shape it is, to then the one neck and the head coming up, and then after that, then the two other necks and the coming up,” Ueki explained. “So it’s really the step-by-step transformation and giving it attention for each phase of the transformation was the most challenging part.”

But as the team broke it down even further, the various phases of King Ghidorah ended being handled by different artists focusing their efforts on certain parts, “Different artists actually worked on the different parts,” Ueki continued. “When it comes to the more dragon-like animation, we actually had a member who had just returned from some work in Hollywood. So that person was assigned to really hone in and focus on the animation of making it look like a dragon and making it feel real. And then we also had a separate person working on the effects.” It really was a team effort all around for the Godzilla Minus Zero crew .

Godzilla Minus Zero ‘s Team Worked Hard for King Ghidorah

“So really, it came down to every part of Ghidorah being handled by a very specialized artist, a team member that made it happen,” Ueki explained. “Then when it comes to the gravity beam, that was handled by [Tatsumi] Nojima here and the rest of the team. So I think it was absolute teamwork to make Ghidorah come alive.” That result comes through on screen in the final project for sure, and that’s been responded in kind with all kinds of box office records already broken .

It’s yet to be revealed whether or not Godzilla Minus Zero will lead to a potential third film to cap off a trilogy for writer and director Takashi Yamazaki , and that means there could be even more of an opportunity for King Ghidorah’s own return in the future too. If there’s a different monster coming to the franchise, the visual effects team shook take a cue from this effort and make it a fully collaborative process to make the best result possible.

What did you think of King Ghidorah’s look in Godzilla Minus Zero ? What’s your favorite version of its design? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Confirms It Will End After 5 Years With Next Release
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump is gearing up to end its next major series with its final chapter’s release planned after five years of serialization. It’s been a long year of endings within the pages of Shonen Jump magazine, and unfortunately the majority of these endings have been brought about by early cancellations. Even with all of that being said, there have been a number of the longer running hits all within their respective final arcs as fans have been gearing up for their grand finales.

But while all eyes had been on Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days as it has openly been in the midst of its final battle, the same has actually been true for Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch . And with the end of that battle in the latest chapter, it’s now been revealed that Witch Watch will be coming to an end with its next chapter after five long years of serialization and nearly 300 chapters under its belt. It’s time to get ready to say goodbye to another long running series.

Witch Watch to End With Shonen Jump After Five Years

Witch Watch kicked off the final arc of its manga run back in November 2025. While some of its developments back then made it seem like the series was going to be ending much sooner than expected, it was all to eventually reveal that the manga was actually going to be starting “Part 3” of its story as the existence of witches became public to start a war that has lasted for the past year’s worth of chapters. It ended up giving the franchise a whole new phase of life with lots of battles working out since then.

Witch Watch was far from ending even after having Morihito and Nico expressing their long held feelings for one another , and it meant that there wasn’t enough time for them to actually sit in those feelings before more intense fights kicked off from then on. It’s been nothing but one strong fight after another, and Chapter 269 of the series sees Morihito dealing the final blow to end the fight once and for all. And that means the series is ready to end with its final chapter on Chapter 270.

Is Witch Watch Really Over?

With Witch Watch coming to an end with Chapter 270 releasing next week, it does make one wonder whether or not this truly is the end for the long running series. There was a fake out after what seemed to be the final fight before with the reveal of one final villain , but now even that final villain has been taken care of. It doesn’t seem like it’s going to be yet another fake out, and instead it’s going to be the end as even more series start to release in the magazine to take its spot.

This marks the fifth major series coming to its actual end within Shonen Jump this year following Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo, Hima-ten!, Blue Box and The Elusive Samurai. Coupled with the eight cancelled series from the year, this marks the 13th title to end with the magazine for 2026 overall. It might not be the only one ending soon either as all eyes are looking to Sakamoto Days ‘ final battle next , so what do you think of Witch Watch ending next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: One Piece’s Luffy Goes Berserk With Shocking New Gear 5 Form
content:
One Piece has reached the climax of the Elbaph Arc with its latest few chapters, and the newest chapter has introduced a shocking new transformation to the series as Luffy has unleashed a berserk new version of his Gear 5 form. One Piece has been pitting Luffy against his strongest opponent yet as the mysterious King Imu finally made his move , and it’s revealed just how strong the king really is. His devilish power has made things even tougher, and Luffy has been pushed far beyond his limits.

Luffy’s usual style of being beaten to the brink before recovering his abilities and eventually winning at the end of the day isn’t working out against Imu , and it was seemed like he was going to be worst off than ever when last seeing him in action. But the newest chapter of Eiichiro Oda’s One Piece has seemingly made things even worse as Luffy has seemingly gone berserk with a new level of his Devil Fruit transformation.

One Piece Chapter 1198 Unlocks Luffy’s Gear 5 Berserk Form

When Luffy was last seen in the manga, he and Loki had been able to push Imu back but the villain’s recovery abilities made him much stronger than the duo. Luffy had been struggling to regain his footing as he was seemingly losing access to the Gear Fifth form, but now things have gotten much worse. With the latest few chapters shifting their focus to Sanji and Zoro’s respective fights, some big things have gone down for Luffy while fans weren’t paying attention. Imu’s gotten much stronger than ever before.

One Piece Chapter 1198 reveals Imu’s now giant form that towers even over Loki as the villain notes how much power he’s used through this fight for now. This seems to have had some impact on Luffy as well as the others have noted how Luffy ran away from the fight without any real reason. Knowing Luffy is far from the kind of person that would do such a thing, it’s soon revealed that his Mythical Zoan type Devil Fruit has awakened some kind of wild power within him. Making him a lot more beast and monkey like as a result.

What’s Going on With This New Luffy Form?

This new version of Gear 5 Luffy is a lot more chaotic and doing its own thing, but it seems to be much stronger than Luffy ever was. It instantly wipes out the God of Rain that had been previously summoned before, but Luffy doesn’t seem to be in control as this new version of him can do nothing but cackle at the action. It was teased that Killingham’s Devil Fruit images couldn’t be completely wiped out due to their ethereal nature , but Luffy’s new form had no trouble with it whatsoever.

As Luffy continues to unlock new levels to his original Gum-Gum Fruit through each of these arcs, this is now clearly the next major stage of his evolution into whatever the Sun God Nika really was . If this is a form that Luffy can get control over, it could be what he needs to truly become the King of the Pirates. If this is a form that’s instead something that falls more into Imu’s power, however, then it’s going to be a very tough path forward.

How are you feeling about Luffy’s new Gear 5 form? What are you hoping to see from him next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
